lines.zh: 我背着壳走过白桦林，树皮很白。
lines.en: I carry my shell through the birches, bark pale around me.

lines.zh: 林子越暗，我走得越慢。
lines.en: The darker the wood, the slower I go.

lines.zh: 我的壳擦过树干，留下一道湿痕。
lines.en: My shell scrapes a trunk, leaving a wet trail.

lines.zh: 黑森林的蕨类比我高，我照样走。
lines.en: Dark forest ferns tower over me, and I walk on.

lines.zh: 一步一寸，我不赶时间。
lines.en: An inch a step, I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 落叶太厚，我几乎陷进去。
lines.en: The leaf litter is so deep I nearly sink.

lines.zh: 我绕开蘑菇圈，那里不属于我。
lines.en: I avoid the mushroom ring; it is not mine.

lines.zh: 森林的根须替我指路。
lines.en: The roots show me the way.

lines.zh: 壳上长着苔，走起来沙沙响。
lines.en: Moss grows on my shell and rustles as I move.

lines.zh: 我从白桦走到黑森林，天就黑了。
lines.en: Birch to dark forest, and the day ended.

lines.zh: 我的身体比壳软，所以走得小心。
lines.en: My body is softer than my shell, so I step carefully.

lines.zh: 前面有光，我要去看看那是什么。
lines.en: There is light ahead. I will see what it is.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳里，听见外面在滴水。
lines.en: I pull into my shell and hear water dripping.

lines.zh: 苔藓在我背上安家，我不赶它。
lines.en: Moss has settled on my back. I let it stay.

lines.zh: 森林很吵，鸟、风、还有虫子。
lines.en: The wood is loud: birds, wind, insects.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面，能听见树根喝水。
lines.en: Pressed to the ground, I hear roots drinking.

lines.zh: 壳上的纹路一年长一圈。
lines.en: A ring of my shell grows each year.

lines.zh: 我什么都不做，森林也不会催我。
lines.en: I do nothing, and the wood does not hurry me.

lines.zh: 有只蜗牛爬过，我们互相看了一眼。
lines.en: A snail passes and we glance at each other.

lines.zh: 阳光落在壳上，暖了一小块。
lines.en: Sunlight lands on my shell and warms one small patch.

lines.zh: 我在等雨，雨来了壳会亮。
lines.en: I wait for rain. Rain makes my shell shine.

lines.zh: 身体里有什么在慢慢长，很沉。
lines.en: Something inside me grows slowly, and heavily.

lines.zh: 我数着白桦的年轮，数不到头。
lines.en: I count birch rings and never reach the end.

lines.zh: 风把落叶推到我面前，我绕过去。
lines.en: Wind pushes leaves at me and I go around.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很慢，慢到像没有。
lines.en: My breathing is so slow it seems absent.

lines.zh: 这块石头我坐了三年，形状刚好。
lines.en: I have sat on this stone three years; it fits.

lines.zh: 壳口有一滴水，挂在边上
lines.en: A drop of water hangs at my shell's mouth.

lines.zh: 森林的味道变湿了，要下雨
lines.en: The forest smells wet; rain is coming.

lines.zh: 你踩到的不是树枝，是我的邻居。
lines.en: What you stepped on was not a twig but my neighbor.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，壳跟着晃了一下。
lines.en: I lift my head and my shell rocks once.

lines.zh: 你身上有斧子的味道。
lines.en: You smell of axe.

lines.zh: 我在看你，从壳口的缝里。
lines.en: I watch you through the gap of my shell mouth.

lines.zh: 别低头，我不喜欢被俯视。
lines.en: Do not look down at me. I dislike it.

lines.zh: 你站得很直，像被种下去的。
lines.en: You stand so straight, as if planted.

lines.zh: 你的靴子上有黑森林的泥。
lines.en: There is dark forest mud on your boots.

lines.zh: 我认得你的脚步声，来回两趟了。
lines.en: I know your steps. You have passed twice.

lines.zh: 你把火把举低些，我看看你的脸。
lines.en: Lower the torch. Let me see your face.

lines.zh: 你看起来不像会剥树皮的人。
lines.en: You do not look like one who strips bark.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过头，很久才转完。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly, and it takes a while.

lines.zh: 你等得不耐烦，我还在看。
lines.en: You grow impatient. I am still looking.

lines.zh: 森林让我们遇上了，就这样。
lines.en: The forest put us here together. That is all.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我壳上，凉。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my shell, cool.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一道，里面露了出来。
lines.en: A crack in my shell; what is inside shows.

lines.zh: 疼，但我缩得比你想的快。
lines.en: It hurts, but I withdraw faster than you think.

lines.zh: 你把壳当石头敲，敲错了。
lines.en: You knocked my shell like a stone. Wrong stone.

lines.zh: 我的身体软，壳不软。
lines.en: My body is soft. My shell is not.

lines.zh: 这一下让我缩回去半天。
lines.en: That blow keeps me withdrawn half a day.

lines.zh: 裂缝会自己长好，要等一个雨季。
lines.en: The crack heals itself, but it takes a rainy season.

lines.zh: 你踢我，脚趾断的不一定是我。
lines.en: Kick me, and the broken toe may not be mine.

lines.zh: 我发出很低的一声，像磨石头。
lines.en: I make a low sound, like stone grinding.

lines.zh: 别打壳口，那里最薄。
lines.en: Not the shell mouth. That is thinnest.

lines.zh: 再裂一次，我就丢掉这个壳。
lines.en: One more crack and I abandon this shell.

lines.zh: 那片嫩叶，是留给我的吗？
lines.en: Is that tender leaf meant for me?

lines.zh: 雨水顺着叶片流下来，我有点想喝。
lines.en: Rain runs down the leaf and I would like a sip.

lines.zh: 你手里的苔藓，看起来很新鲜。
lines.en: The moss in your hand looks fresh.

lines.zh: 我朝那个方向挪了一寸。
lines.en: I shift an inch that way.

lines.zh: 菌盖上的露水，甜得很淡。
lines.en: The dew on that cap is faintly sweet.

lines.zh: 别拿走，我还没决定要不要。
lines.en: Do not take it yet. I have not decided.

lines.zh: 你撒下的碎叶，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the crushed leaves you scattered.

lines.zh: 我饿了很久，壳都变轻了。
lines.en: I have hungered long; my shell feels lighter.

lines.zh: 再往前一点，我就够到了。
lines.en: A little farther and I can reach it.

lines.zh: 食物收起来，我就慢下来。
lines.en: Put the food away and I slow down.

lines.zh: 你踢到我的壳，脚趾该疼了。
lines.en: You kicked my shell. Your toe must hurt.

lines.zh: 我太矮了，你根本没看见我。
lines.en: I am too low. You never saw me.

lines.zh: 壳被撞歪，我花了很久才摆正。
lines.en: My shell knocked askew; it took long to right.

lines.zh: 别用脚拨我，我不是石头。
lines.en: Do not nudge me with your foot. I am not a stone.

lines.zh: 你退开，我要从这里过去。
lines.en: Step aside. I am passing through here.

lines.zh: 我们撞上时，发出很闷的一声。
lines.en: We collided with a dull, muffled sound.

lines.zh: 壳比靴子硬，磕坏的不是我。
lines.en: My shell's harder; the boot dents, not me.

lines.zh: 被推了一下，我滑了半尺。
lines.en: One push and I slid half a foot.

lines.zh: 让路吧，我走得慢，但不会停。
lines.en: Give way. I am slow, but I do not stop.

lines.zh: 你踩滑了，正好踩在我旁边。
lines.en: You slipped and landed right beside me.

lines.zh: 森林里像我这样的，不多。
lines.en: There are few like me in this wood.

lines.zh: 我留下一道湿痕，希望它跟上来。
lines.en: I leave a wet trail, hoping it follows.

lines.zh: 慢的东西，找伴也慢。
lines.en: Slow things find companions slowly.

lines.zh: 壳和壳碰一下，就算认识了。
lines.en: Shell against shell, and we are acquainted.

lines.zh: 我等着，反正我活得很久。
lines.en: I will wait. I live a long time.

lines.zh: 白桦林那边有一只，我见过两次。
lines.en: There is one by the birches. I have seen it twice.

lines.zh: 我们并排走，一天走不了十步。
lines.en: Side by side, we manage ten steps a day.

lines.zh: 它留下的痕迹是新的，我跟着。
lines.en: Its trail is fresh, so I follow.

lines.zh: 成双之后，壳会贴在一起过冬。
lines.en: Paired, our shells press together through winter.

lines.zh: 这是我的孩子，壳里的小东西。
lines.en: This is my young one, small inside the shell.

lines.zh: 我捡起一片落叶，压在壳下。
lines.en: I take a fallen leaf and press it under my shell.

lines.zh: 这粒种子掉在路上，我带走。
lines.en: A seed fell on the path. I will carry it.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我用身体盖住了。
lines.en: I have covered what you dropped with my body.

lines.zh: 小石子我搬不动，只能绕开。
lines.en: The pebble is too much; I go around it.

lines.zh: 我把苔藓卷起来，留到冬天。
lines.en: I roll up moss to keep for winter.

lines.zh: 壳里能塞一点，塞不下太多。
lines.en: A little fits under my shell, not much.

lines.zh: 这片白桦皮，我收着当垫子。
lines.en: This birch bark I keep for bedding.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地推，把它推到树根边。
lines.en: I push it slowly to the tree roots.

lines.zh: 东西太小，我一低头就看不见。
lines.en: It is so small I lose it when I lower my head.

lines.zh: 我捡的不是宝贝，是路。
lines.en: What I pick up is not treasure but road.

lines.zh: 你砍了白桦，树倒的声音传得很远。
lines.en: You felled a birch; the crash carried far.

lines.zh: 我的壳下，有一窝刚成形的卵。
lines.en: Under my shell lies a clutch of new-formed eggs.

lines.zh: 黑森林安静下来，因为你。
lines.en: The dark forest went quiet, and it was you.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了菌环，那是界线。
lines.en: You crushed the mushroom ring. That was a boundary.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，这次抬得很快。
lines.en: I raise my head, and quickly this time.

lines.zh: 森林把账算给我，我只能照办。
lines.en: The forest hands me the debt, and I settle it.

lines.zh: 你带了火，这比斧子更糟。
lines.en: You brought fire. That is worse than an axe.

lines.zh: 我认得你的气味，第三次了。
lines.en: I know your scent. This is the third time.

lines.zh: 我的邻居少了一个，是你。
lines.en: One of my neighbors is gone, and it was you.

lines.zh: 壳口对着你，里面黑得看不见。
lines.en: My shell mouth faces you, black and unreadable.

lines.zh: 别往林子深处走，那里归我。
lines.en: Do not go deeper. That part belongs to me.

lines.zh: 你脚下那棵苗，我种了六年。
lines.en: That sapling underfoot took me six years.

lines.zh: 伤害你会很慢，但会很彻底。
lines.en: Hurting you will be slow, and complete.

lines.zh: 树根已经记住你的位置。
lines.en: The roots have your position now.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面移动，你听不见。
lines.en: I move along the ground; you hear nothing.

lines.zh: 落叶在动，那是我在下面。
lines.en: The leaves stir. That is me underneath.

lines.zh: 你的影子边上，多了一道湿痕。
lines.en: A wet streak has joined the edge of your shadow.

lines.zh: 我绕树一圈，你还在原地找。
lines.en: I circle a tree while you search where I was.

lines.zh: 我慢，但你的路更慢。
lines.en: I am slow, but your road is slower.

lines.zh: 你往左，我爬也先到左边。
lines.en: Left? I'll crawl there first.

lines.zh: 壳口的冷气已经碰到你的鞋。
lines.en: Cold from my shell mouth has reached your shoe.

lines.zh: 白桦的根在我身后合拢。
lines.en: The birch roots close behind me.

lines.zh: 你数着树，我数着你的脚步。
lines.en: You count trees; I count your steps.

lines.zh: 再走十步，你就进黑森林了。
lines.en: Ten more steps and you enter the dark forest.

lines.zh: 我不喊，森林替我出声。
lines.en: I do not call out. The forest speaks for me.

lines.zh: 你回头时，我已经在另一棵树后。
lines.en: When you turn, I am behind another tree.

lines.zh: 别跑，跑起来根须会绊你。
lines.en: Do not run. Running is when the roots trip you.

lines.zh: 快了，等你走到那棵倒木旁边。
lines.en: Soon, when you reach that fallen log.

lines.zh: 我看见你的影子短了一截
lines.en: I see your shadow has grown shorter.

lines.zh: 壳口一合，咬住你的脚踝。
lines.en: My shell mouth closes on your ankle.

lines.zh: 壳的边缘很薄，割开了你的手。
lines.en: My shell rim is thin, and it opens your hand.

lines.zh: 冷气钻进你的伤口，会麻。
lines.en: Cold enters the wound and numbness follows.

lines.zh: 我把你拖向树根，一步步来。
lines.en: I drag you toward the roots, one step at a time.

lines.zh: 这一击很慢，但你没躲开。
lines.en: This strike was slow, and you did not dodge.

lines.zh: 你倒下时压坏了三棵苗。
lines.en: Falling, you crushed three saplings.

lines.zh: 壳里伸出什么东西，你最好别看。
lines.en: Something reaches from my shell. Better not look.

lines.zh: 咬住就不松，除非你不动。
lines.en: Once I bite, I hold until you stop moving.

lines.zh: 这一下是替那棵白桦。
lines.en: That blow was for the birch.

lines.zh: 我退回去了，壳上沾着你的味道。
lines.en: I withdraw, my shell carrying your scent.

lines.zh: 我从腐叶下面钻出来，壳还是湿的。
lines.en: I crawl from under rotting leaves, shell still wet.

lines.zh: 白桦林里多了一个会走的石头。
lines.en: The birch wood has gained a walking stone.

lines.zh: 黑森林的雾散了，我就在那儿。
lines.en: The dark forest mist cleared, and there I was.

lines.zh: 苔藓从我的壳上开始长。
lines.en: Moss begins to grow on my shell.

lines.zh: 这棵树倒了三年，我一直住在下面。
lines.en: This tree fell three years ago; I live beneath it.

lines.zh: 雨停的时候，我从泥里爬出来。
lines.en: When the rain stopped, I crawled out of the mud.

lines.zh: 森林需要清道的人，我来了。
lines.en: The forest needed a sweeper, so I came.

lines.zh: 我第一次呼吸，闻到了树皮的味道。
lines.en: My first breath smelled of bark.

lines.zh: 周围很暗，正合我意。
lines.en: It is dark here. That suits me.

lines.zh: 我的壳还没有硬，但能用了。
lines.en: My shell is not hard yet, but it serves.

lines.zh: 一窝卵里，只有我爬出来。
lines.en: From a clutch of eggs, only I emerged.

lines.zh: 落叶盖住我，我慢慢顶开它们。
lines.en: Leaves covered me and I pushed them off, slowly.

lines.zh: 我从很远的地方来，走了很多年。
lines.en: I came far, and it took many years.

lines.zh: 这里安静，我可以留下了。
lines.en: It is quiet here. I can stay.

lines.zh: 火烤到壳上，我闻到自己。
lines.en: Fire on my shell, and I smell myself.

lines.zh: 从坡上滚下去，壳响了一路。
lines.en: Rolling downhill, my shell clattered the whole way.

lines.zh: 水漫过壳口，我憋了很久。
lines.en: Water covered my shell mouth and I held on long.

lines.zh: 炸飞了我的壳，我在地上打转。
lines.en: The blast threw my shell off and I spun on the ground.

lines.zh: 箭钉在壳上，像一根刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shell like a thorn.

lines.zh: 魔法穿过壳，直接打到里面。
lines.en: Magic passed my shell and struck what is inside.

lines.zh: 饿久了，壳会变薄，很危险。
lines.en: Hunger thins the shell, and that is dangerous.

lines.zh: 雷落在树上，我壳都震麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hit the tree and my shell went numb.

lines.zh: 掉下去时，我还在找树根。
lines.en: Falling, I was still searching for roots.
